purpose: Enumerates every identity-spine gap and open project decision left Unresolved by the ticket-14 hand-lift, so an honest block is legible and each gap has a named confirmation action. The engine never invents these (D11); the operator supplies them as confirmed facts or beta-declares them via working_assumptions.json (ticket 15), which turns an honest block into a conscious green (W1, ticket 9).
role_token_convention: FELLOW = postdoctoral researcher/applicant; HOST = beneficiary/host organisation; SUPERVISOR = supervisor at host. Structural roles of any MSCA-PF action; the IDENTITY behind each is Unresolved. Role tokens appear in architecture_inputs/*.json in place of names.
status_vocabulary: status values are exactly the four CLAUDE.md §12.2 categories (Confirmed / Inferred / Assumed / Unresolved). No fifth category is introduced. Where the sources provide no basis for a role (ELTE), the status stays Unresolved and the disposition is carried by descriptive fields - source_disposition: 'absent_from_sources' and do_not_invent: true. A fifth status value would bypass both honesty gates (no_unresolved_material_claims fails only on 'unresolved'; W1 governs only 'assumed') and would be a de facto change to §12.2's vocabulary without an amendment (§14.1). See decision_log/status-vocabulary-correction_2026-07-13.json.
